principle: The LLM BRAIN itself runs CHEAP by default — GLM-5.2 / Kimi-k2.7-code via Ollama (cloud or local) — as the orchestrator, reviewer, and distiller-judge that drives a capability from unbounded+inefficient toward most-bounded+most-efficient. Escalate to a frontier model ONLY when the cheap default fails a confidence/quality bar. This is the descent applied to the brain itself: cheapest-capable orchestration, frontier only when it must. Auth via OLLAMA_API_KEY (env ref; the value lives in the gitignored .env, never tracked). The brain PROPOSES; the eval/policy gates DISPOSE — serves_truth=false.

roles.escalate_when: a multi-step plan fails validation or planning confidence < bar
review uncertainty is high or the change is high-blast-radius
eval judges disagree or the measured lift is borderline
